stylizedBase: Use case: style-transfer. Redesign this blank letter-paper asset in a CLEARLY STYLIZED, charming premium Japanese fantasy GAME UI art style. The user dislikes realistic old paper. Strong confident warm-brown outlines, simplified sculpted cartoon forms, clean cel-painted shading, saturated but elegant honey gold, ivory and muted lavender accents. Exaggerate thickness of the rounded paper edge. Replace tiny realistic rococo filigree with larger simplified gold leaf curls and small stylized rose corner ornaments, crisp hand-drawn 2D game inventory art. Gold has just three bold light/mid/shadow tones with an intentional cream highlight, NOT realistic metal texture. Paper center almost smooth warm cream, NO grunge, no photo fibers. Ornament confined to the OUTERMOST 6 percent rim, empty spacious center for interface text. Almost square portrait proportions 265:278, paper fills the entire image edge to edge, front-facing orthographic. Keep all text areas empty. NO text, numbers, lettering, seals, objects, checkerboard, drop shadows outside the paper, or background scenery. A delightful polished game asset with a visible hand-drawn silhouette, not a certificate, not a photo.

Genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, no table, floor, scenery or external cast shadow. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, or checkered backdrop. Crisp painterly cartoon inventory asset, attractive at small size; beautiful intentional shape language, not a generic flat vector icon.
